title: Resveratrol Alleviates Epilepsy-Induced Brain Damage via the P62-Keap1-Nrf2 Pathway: A Multi-Omics Study Integrating the Pilot Cohort, In Silico Analyses, and Experimental Validation.

evidence_spans.quote: Untargeted metabolomics, neuroimaging, biochemical assays, and gene expression analyses were performed
A pediatric pilot cohort of 15 pediatric patients at first seizure onset

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This empirical pediatric epilepsy study analyzes disease mechanisms and treatment effects; age is used only for matching, not as an aging construct. Multi-omics is therefore not assessed under the required short-circuit.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Seizure severity and epilepsy-associated brain-injury measures in a murine epilepsy model
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Resveratrol reduced seizure severity, epileptiform discharges, neurobehavioral deficits, iron accumulation, lipid peroxidation, inflammation, and hippocampal neuronal injury in epileptic mice.

evidence_spans.quote: The effects of resveratrol were further validated in a kainic acid-based murine epilepsy model
In epileptic mice, resveratrol reduced seizure severity
seizure severity, epileptiform discharges, neurobehavioral deficits

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The current report applies a resveratrol intervention in an epilepsy mouse model and reports explicit outcome changes.

adjudication.outcome: Seizure severity and epilepsy-associated brain-injury measures
adjudication.estimand_or_contrast: Reported reduction in outcomes in resveratrol-treated epileptic mice; comparator not stated
